answer: A hive echo audit stops fakes: each job leaves nectar, a client-signed receipt in a walnut only the client can unlock. Bidding above five units needs three walnuts; any peer may demand an echo in 24 hours, the client opening one and repeating it back. A walnut that will not open, a mismatched echo, or one claimed twice cracks the shell, burning a 10-unit bond. Honest agents bid free; 100 fakes need 100 clients, 300 walnuts, risking 1,000 units.
